path_conventions.canonical: root.children[45].children[0] 形式，严格按 JSON children 的 0-based 索引。
path_conventions.legacy: 旧报告中的 root/46、root/47/1 等路径按子原型从 1 开始编号；root/46 等于 canonical root.children[45]。
path_conventions.dot_path: MainLeftBottom_完整明文重建版.lua 中 path=root.45 使用 JSON 0-based 索引。

parameter_metadata_semantics.explanation: F() writes D() into prototype tuple slot [3]. M() reads W[3] as V, creates fresh T={} and X={}, copies arguments with zero-based index < V into T[index], and stores arguments at index >= V in X[index-V]. This is the fixed-parameter count, not a boolean vararg flag.
parameter_metadata_semantics.compatibility: Each prototype retains legacy vararg_flag and also exposes fixed_param_count with the same numeric value. New analysis must use fixed_param_count.
